# Macro, Bitcoin, and Oilfield Services Update

Report 150 | Published 2024-11-24 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-11-24/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/150.json)

Fiscal-cut skepticism and oil-service reassessment.

Fiscal-cut skepticism was strongly supported, while the one-year bitcoin direction was wrong despite a higher intervening peak. Tentative SLB/HAL bottom signals failed and later operating results weakened, so low multiples did not eliminate business risk. EPD income continuity and MSTR accumulation were better supported.

**Coverage:** All text read, including employee arithmetic, macro assumptions, bitcoin/MSTR, ETH update, SLB/HAL and EPD tax note. Historical quoted forecasts preserve prior-family links and are not independent wins. Corporate strategy descriptions included only where they support investment reasoning.
